description: Dated events that change how Wikipedia pageviews are measured. The analysis matches detected level changes against these (±1 month) and adds `note` as a caveat when a window extends past one; `detail` is background for people.

events.label: Wikimedia bot-detection update
events.note: raw counts are not comparable across it; shares of edition views are affected much less.
events.detail: Wikimedia reclassified traffic after improving bot detection in May 2025 and reported about 8% fewer human pageviews in Mar–Aug 2025 than a year earlier.
